summary: The SiteOpportunity module handles the management of site-specific opportunities in the system. It includes entity definitions, CRUD operations, list retrieval, and logic to format, validate, and control the presentation of opportunity data. Workflows include adding, updating, deleting, copying, and fetching SiteOpportunities by various parameters. Formatting and validation ensure display correctness and business rules compliance.
purpose: To provide a structured way to manage site opportunities, allowing users to add, update, delete, retrieve, and present these opportunities with formatting and validation appropriate for UI consumption and business rules.

fields.name: DescriptionFormatted
fields.description: UI-ready description, based on language preference

fields.name: WebPage
fields.description: True if entry is a web page record

fields.name: HeaderChanged
fields.description: True if heading/category changed for display grouping

steps: Set parameters: SiteID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder

steps: Check ID is not 0 and Valid
Set parameters: SiteOpportunitiesID, HeadingID, Response, SortOrder

workflows.name: Get SiteOpportunities by SiteID
steps: Execute and map results to list

workflows.name: FillList (data mapping for UI)
steps: Construct SiteOpportunity entity from DB fields
Set WebPage flag if description matches special value

business_rules: SortOrder of -1 is treated as blank for display
DescriptionFormatted uses alternate language if session setting is enabled
WebPage flag set when Description matches Resources.WEB_PAGE
HeaderChanged set true when HeadingID changes on subsequent entries
validations: Response must not be blank (add error message and prevent operation if blank)
calculations: SortOrderFormatted: blank if SortOrder == -1, else string value
DescriptionFormatted: DescriptionAlt if session language setting, else Description
conditions: Entry is a web page if Description == Resources.WEB_PAGE
HeaderChanged if HeadingID differs from previous entry
system_behavior: Maps database rows to strongly-typed entities for UI and business logic
Resets numbering and header grouping as display context changes
dependencies: HSPnetSession (provides DB access and session context)
exceptions: Add/Update fails if Response is blank with error message
No operations performed if SiteOpportunity ID is 0
